segments.text: You have been very good about writing, for we like so much to hear all about the place & your companions &c.— I suppose the country is flat & ugly; so I fancy all
is, but I never entered the county.— It looks here, as if you would have skating, which would be a good job.—
You must know that I have determined to sell the grey mare; for
she started so violently in the tax-cart & ran up a bank that she very nearly upset the cart.— I shall try
offer her for 25£.— Perhaps you will say, as
, “Well that is cool to bag my chair”.— It will not be worth while to buy for
, without something very good turned up, but we must look out before
; indeed it is very inconvenient for us being with only one horse.—
